name: Doki Doki Literature Club: Episode Natsuki
source:
You already know who Natsuki is. Being one of the five members of Monika's Literature Club, she writes cute and calm poems about serious manners, such as how everyone judges other people, or how people can end up never achieving what they want, and so on. But, how and why did she decided to join a club about writing poems? How did she ended up meeting her friends? Who was Natsuki before the story started?
Unfortunately, before everything began, Natsuki's life wasn't so easy. With so many problems she couldn't deal with, the poor girl's life as a living hell. With people who judged her for the things she liked, no success in having people who cared about her and a father that mistreated her, Natsuki just wanted to find a solution to all of her problems. In the end... Did Natsuki discover a solution to stop her life from being so... Terrible? Find out in Doki Doki: Literature Club - Episode Natsuki.

Doki Doki: Literature Club - Episode Natsuki is a Visual Novel that is set before the original Doki Doki game. It focuses on Natsuki's life with her abusive father and offers an explanation of how she got into the Literature Club, and met her friends.

   - PLAY AS NATSUKI: See the entire story from Natsuki's point of view, and take a look at her life with her friends and abusive dad.
   - A WHOLE NEW STORY: Episode Natsuki offers to the player a brand new fan-made story about Doki Doki: Literature Club, set before the original game.
   - MEET THEM ONCE AGAIN: For one more time, meet Monika, Yuri and Sayori, before everything began.
   - IN THE END: ... Will Natsuki find the happiness she deserves?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/natsukivisualnovel/451708]Gamejolt[/url]]
translation:
你已经知道夏树是谁。她是莫妮卡文学部的五名成员之一，会写下可爱而平静的诗，探讨“人们如何评判他人”“人最终可能无法实现愿望”等严肃话题。但是，她为什么、又是如何决定加入一个写诗社团的？她是如何遇见朋友们的？故事开始前的夏树又是什么样？

遗憾的是，一切开始之前，夏树的生活并不轻松。她无法处理那么多问题，悲惨的生活简直像地狱。人们因为她喜欢的事物而评判她，没有人真正在乎她，父亲还虐待她；夏树只想找到解决所有问题的方法。最后……夏树发现让生活不再如此……糟糕的办法了吗？游玩《心跳文学部：夏树篇》，寻找答案吧。

《心跳文学部：夏树篇》是一部发生在原作《心跳文学部》之前的视觉小说，聚焦夏树与虐待她的父亲共同生活的经历，并解释她如何加入文学部、结识朋友。

- 扮演夏树：从夏树的视角体验完整故事，了解她与朋友和虐待自己的父亲共同生活的点滴。
- 全新故事：体验一段以原作之前为背景的《心跳文学部》同人故事。
- 再次相遇：在一切开始前，再次见到莫妮卡、尤里和莎莉。
- 最后的问题：……夏树能找到自己应得的幸福吗？

（来源：[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/natsukivisualnovel/451708]Gamejolt[/url]）
